notes.title: Dato of Srivijaya update 25 January 2022
notes.content:
Hello everyone, 


After long time not give any information about the update, now we have time to update in this community.

Now we want show many new update for Dato of Srivijaya

[b]Navy[/b]
In this version, you can see the new interface for navy

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39072969/41b6c472331e652b4fbd8b0900652916d5ee5fe0.jpg[/img]

[b]Sea battle[/b]

Sea battle information in new version Dato of Srivijaya. You can choose options: firing with arrows and boarding (like in Perang Laut-Maritime Warfare)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39072969/22036aff301b1a1567164aa0cc1003fccbd2514f.jpg[/img]

[b]Land battle [/b]
In land batle, you can order your troops in fighting from offensive, half offensive, and defensive. 
Offensive for order troops attacking the enemy
Half offensive means not all troops attacking like archer.
Defensive means all troops will foces in defending their position
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39072969/55dd5d6ba05917fc173d0c8d7ee9ad39b57d0baf.jpg[/img]

[b]Siege[/b]

Now you can choose order in siege the town from just siege them, firing with arrow, or offensive
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39072969/523cb0f342b8b9928cd05a6b3cdff4d7201ce347.jpg[/img]


This is what we can told in this section.

When will we update the build and homepage? Soon

Thank you

Sengkala Dev

notes.title: Dato of Srivijaya 1.05 version has been released!
notes.content:
After 2.5 months developing 1.05 (lot of problems happen since only one programmer working).,
Dato of Srivijaya 1.05 has been released!!

In this version, many new things like.
-> You can play Mataram (Javanese), Sunda(Sundanese), and Srivijaya (Malay)
_>Opening visual for Srivijaya
->New visual for town, village, and city depends on region
->Week time to Month time with moon image(but its not change builidng system time).
->Naval battle (for now only Srivijaya, Sunda, and Java can send naval expedition).
->New Achivements !
-> Trade routes Chinese and Indian. Locals will come soon  in 1.07 version


However many plans annonced before pending in 1.07 version.

1.07 will make 1-2 factions can playable and new system like vasal and diplomatic. When this version out?
Hope in early April 2021.

Thank you and enjoy playing Sunda and Mataram .
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39072969/7bf89d9e8feed027ad60c26c7b286b11e761ae4b.jpg[/img]
[b]Some advice[/b]
1.Sunda:Recommend and more easier to control compare Srivijaya, lack of mans in first time, and Mataram, problem of stability.
2.Srivijaya:Need to play to understanding basic of Dato of Srivijaya, but expansion of Srivijaya quite hard since facing Malay.
3.Mataram:Quite hard since stability become first problem before expansion.
